## Senbonzakura 2.0.3 — Entity Renderer Fix (Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge)

### Crash Fix
- Fixed `NullPointerException` when summoning/rendering bosses: registered entity renderers for all 23 bosses
- Tier 1 bosses (King Slime, Zombie General, Skeleton General, Queen Spider) use vanilla renderers
- Iron Golem-based bosses use IronGolemRenderer as placeholder

### All 23 Chaotic Mode Bosses

**Tier 1 — Pre-Iron Worm (Overworld)**
- King Slime — 44 HP — Royal Jelly summon / Spawn Egg
- Zombie General — 80 HP — Putrid Bait summon / Spawn Egg
- Skeleton General — 80 HP — Calcium summon / Spawn Egg
- Queen Spider — 90 HP — Suspicious Bug summon / Spawn Egg
- Iron Worm — 480 HP (12×40) — Corroding Lure summon / Spawn Egg

**Post-Ender Dragon / Wither**
- Werewolf Tribe Chief — 400 HP — Lunar Howl Totem / Spawn Egg
- Sky Serpent — 420 HP — Storm Caller Charm / Spawn Egg
- Hell Serpent — 480 HP — Infernal Totem (Nether-only) / Spawn Egg

**Post-Warden**
- Frozen Serpent — 500 HP — Frost Totem / Spawn Egg
- Kraken Guardian — 520 HP — Deep Totem / Spawn Egg
- Wendigo Warlord — 600 HP — End Totem (End-only) / Spawn Egg

**Post-Wendigo Warlord**
- Sinful Squire — 700 HP — Sinful Totem / Spawn Egg
- Sinful Bishop — 700 HP — Bishop Totem / Spawn Egg
- Sinister Knight — 800 HP — Knight Totem / Spawn Egg

**Post-Sinister Knight — Elemental Heroes**
- Felio, of Flame — 1000 HP — Flame Totem / Spawn Egg
- Ieirith, of Ice — 1000 HP — Ice Totem / Spawn Egg
- Therim, of Thunder — 1000 HP — Thunder Totem / Spawn Egg
- Wahiko, of Wind — 1000 HP — Wind Totem / Spawn Egg
- Sakurai Wahiko, Senbonzakura — 2500 HP — Cherry Totem (Cherry Grove) / Spawn Egg
- Serrik, of Shadow — 1000 HP — Shadow Totem / Spawn Egg

**Final Tier — Chaos**
- Lucius, Retainer of Ruin — 2000 HP — Ruin Totem / Spawn Egg
- Drallius, Visions of Doom — 5000 HP — Visions Totem / Spawn Egg
- Drallius, Chaos: UNLEASHED — 5000 HP — Chaos Totem / Spawn Egg

### Features
- All bosses use Iron Golem placeholder reskins (custom textures needed — see assets.md)
- Custom AI abilities for every boss
- Boss bars (ServerBossEvent) for all bosses
- Anti-despawn on all bosses
- 23 one-time-use summon items with crafting recipes
- 23 spawn eggs in Chaos Mode creative tab
- Full loot tables with specified drop rates
- 22-tier advancement progression tree
- 2 music discs: "Servants of the Scourge" and "Scourge of the Universe & Universal Collapse"

## Senbonzakura 1.9.5 (Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge)

### New wand recipe chain
- **Ducky's Wand** is now crafted shaped/vertical: **Gold Duck Egg** (top), **Breeze Rod** (middle), **Shiny Coin** (bottom).
- **Gold Duck Eggs** are laid by **Gold Ducks**. Gold Ducks cannot spawn naturally — feed any normal duck a Shiny Coin from Ducky's Duck Mod for a **1/15 chance** to turn it into one. Requires Ducky's Duck Mod 1.1.0+.
- Left-click wand shots now spawn a random duck at the impact point which **dies immediately without dropping loot**. Without Ducky's Duck Mod installed, the original duck-sprite projectile effect is used (duck mod is an optional dependency).
- Added the new gold duck transformation to `/droprate`.

### Recap of 1.9.4
- Ducky Domain became a sealed white room with chat notifications removed; Cindering Core and particle textures swapped.

## Senbonzakura 1.9.3 (Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge)

### New: Ducky's Wand
- Craft with **1 Duck Egg + 1 Breeze Rod + 1 Gold Coin**. 19 ATK, 1.6 swings/sec.
- **Left-click** fires duck projectiles that deal **3 hearts of magic damage** — armor is ignored (Protection enchantments still apply).
- **Right-click** opens **Ducky Domain**: all players and mobs within 15 blocks are teleported into a sealed same-world arena for 30 seconds, then returned to their original positions. 120s cooldown.
- The arena uses force-loaded chunks in the same dimension, so there is no cross-dimension loading screen. `/duckydomain` and `/duckydomain end` (OP level 2) let admins inspect or end it early.

### New: Duck Egg
- **1/100 drop** when a Chicken dies by drowning. Included in `/droprate`.

### Also
- Two new placeholder sounds (`duckys_wand_duck`, `duckys_wand_domain`) and matching subtitles, plus placeholder pixel-art textures/models for the wand, ducks, and egg.

Includes everything from 1.9.2: Silverfish Wendigo drop 1/1500 and `/wendigodamage`.

**Jar:** `senbonzakura-1.9.3.jar`

## Senbonzakura 1.9.1 (Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge)

### Custom weapon sounds
- Every weapon now has its own registered sound event with a short placeholder tone, so each ability has a distinct sound.

- **Darkened Rubble:** now 1/1500 from Wither Skeleton, Magma Cube, Blaze, Piglin, Zombified Piglin and Ghast in the Nether.
- **Skystone:** now also drops from Stray at 1/300.

`/droprate` listings and README/Modrinth docs updated to match.

Includes everything from 1.9.0: Matthias' Curseblade and the Stonecutter build migration.

## Senbonzakura 1.9.0 (Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge)

### Matthias' Curseblade
- **9 ATK, 1.6 swing speed.**
- **Passive:** every defeated mob bursts into purple particles and a mob-only blast. Players are never damaged and blocks are never broken.
- Craft (shapeless): 1 Netherite Sword + 1 Sinner's Ash + 1 Tamahagane.
- Includes a simple 16x16 placeholder texture, replaceable with custom art later.

### Build system
- Migrated from ModDevGradle to **Stonecutter + Stonecraft** so additional Minecraft versions and mod loaders can be added incrementally from one source tree.
- The full version × loader matrix is declared in `settings.gradle.kts`; NeoForge 1.21.1 is the only built and verified target for now. Platform-specific entry points are marked with Stonecutter preprocessor directives.

Includes everything from 1.8.1: refreshed item textures, the Cindering enchantment (I-III) with craftable/findable books, the F5 arm tweak, and all prior weapons and features.

## Senbonzakura 1.8.0 (Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge)

### Cindering Enchantment (I–III)
- New data-driven enchantment **`senbonzakura:cindering`**, max level **III**.
- On a direct hit it ignites the target and applies the Cindering potion effect (4s at I, +2s per level). While Cindering is active, fire burns out 2x faster but fire damage taken is 3x higher.
- Works on all Senbonzakura weapons via enchanting table or anvil.

### Enchanted Books up to Cindering III
- **Enchanted Books** with Cindering I, II, or III are obtainable from enchanting tables (with bookshelves).
- Also craftable shapelessly: Book + 1/2/3 Cindering Cores + 1/2/3 Lapis Lazuli for Cindering I/II/III. Combine in an anvil to reach III.
- Added to the `in_enchanting_table` and `non_treasure` enchantment tags, with lang entry and item tag.

### Visual tweaks
- **F5:** left arm keeps its grip pose; right arm angles a little further toward the centre.
- **Sentence:** reduced held-item scale so it no longer renders oversized.
- First-person holds are unchanged; previous crash fix and Crypt/Crescent 360° spins and Razor Shark visuals are all included.

Docs (README / Modrinth) updated, including the all-items table and enchantment section.

**Jar:** `senbonzakura-1.8.0.jar`

## Senbonzakura 1.7.10 (Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge)

**Crash fix:** v1.7.9 could fail to apply the third-person arm-pose mixin because it tried to `@Shadow` the inherited `EntityModel.attackTime` field from a `HumanoidModel` mixin. That aborted resource reload, leaving the main menu blank and causing a later particle crash. The swing is now read from the player entity (`getAttackAnim`) instead, so no inherited field is shadowed.

Everything else from v1.7.9 is unchanged (first-person arm restored, bigger F5 swing, Crypt Blade 360° spin, Razor Shark aim stream/thick beam).

**Jar:** `senbonzakura-1.7.10.jar`

- **Crypt Blade two-handed hold:** in first person, a second arm now grips the blade when your offhand is empty (similar to the vanilla crossbow/map hold). If you put an item in your offhand, the normal offhand item is shown instead.
